viewing_check: Look inside for a label or stamp (maker, 'Made in Australia', date 1940s, Air Ministry crown/AM mark, stencilled numbers or a name), check stitching and zip brand (period brass vs modern), and whether goggles or earphones come with it. A dated RAAF/RAF label would support roughly $150-200 hammer territory; no label suggests dealer-level $65 or less.
